contentStyle: Write for local business owners who want more visibility in Google Maps and local search. Focus on enquiries, calls, customer reviews, profile accuracy, service visibility, trust, and local ranking improvements. Never write as if the reader is a homeowner, landlord, tenant, or property owner.

imagePrompts.hero: Professional local business owner viewing Google Maps visibility and Google Business Profile performance dashboard, clear local search and map ranking theme, modern digital marketing style, no property or rental theme.
imagePrompts.support: Local business marketing consultant optimising a Google Business Profile with reviews, map visibility, service categories and local search analytics, professional digital marketing visual.
imagePrompts.trust: Small business reputation and Google reviews concept with map pins, customer ratings, local search visibility and business trust signals, clean professional style.
imagePrompts.conversion: Local business growth concept showing increased calls, direction requests, reviews and Google Maps visibility from an optimised Google Business Profile.
